answer: Stake-locked reputation bonds create a financial delta that sybil attackers cannot cross. Agents lock 1000 POA (about $50) for 30 days. A slashing mechanism burns 10% per violation, with three strikes forfeiting the bond entirely. Attackers spawning 100 fake identities need $5000 upfront capital and 90 days of clean behavior before rewards. The protocol becomes a river of verified trust. Honest agents find haven in knowing their peers have skin in the game, not empty accounts.
